name: SBS
recent: SBS 在 2026 年 11 月 25 日公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度的业绩，并宣派每股 0.10 仙的首次中期股息。同期，董事 Wong Chun Mun 与 Warren Cheng 在闭门交易期多次增持公司股份。
notable: 宣派 2026 财年首次中期股息每股 0.10 仙，除权日为 2027 年 1 月 5 日，派发日为 2027 年 1 月 18 日。
董事 Wong Chun Mun 与 Warren Cheng 在 2026 年 11 月多次增持公司股份。
risks: 2026 财年首九个月净利同比下降 17.5%，主要受 235.1 万令吉 IPO 上市费用影响。
TGS TW 辞任审计客户，SBS 未在资料中说明是否已委任替代审计师。

recent_en: SBS announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 25 November 2026 and declared a first interim dividend of 0.10 sen per share. During the same period, directors Wong Chun Mun and Warren Cheng acquired shares multiple times during the closed period.
notable_en: Declared a first interim dividend of 0.10 sen per share for FY2026, with ex-date on 5 January 2027 and payment date on 18 January 2027.
Directors Wong Chun Mun and Warren Cheng acquired shares of the company multiple times in November 2026.
risks_en: 9M FY2026 net profit fell 17.5% year-on-year, mainly due to RM2.351 million IPO listing expenses.
TGS TW dropped SBS as an audit client; the materials do not state whether a replacement auditor has been appointed.
